# ranking-metrics

> Rank evaluation over TREC qrels and run files: nDCG@k, MAP, MRR and P@k with trec_eval conventions, plus a paired t-test and an exact or seeded randomization test Python package `trysac-ranking-metrics`, import name `ranking_metrics`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
